title: Has Many Through aur Polymorphic Relations
prerequisites: Many to Many aur Pivot Data (m08-l02)

sections.heading: Has Many Through
sections.body: Country -> User -> Post: ek country ke saare posts, beech ke users ke through. Direct `posts` table mein `country_id` nahi hai, par `hasManyThrough` beech ki table se jod deta hai.

code.code: Country::find(1)->posts;   // is country ke users ke saare posts

explain: Pehla argument final model (`Post`), doosra beech wala (`User`).
`hasOneThrough` isi ka ek-result wala roop hai.

sections.heading: Polymorphic kya hai? (Real-world example: comments)
sections.body: Maan lo Comments Posts par bhi aate hain aur Videos par bhi. Do alag tables (`post_comments`, `video_comments`) banane ki jagah ek `comments` table banao jo batati hai ki wo kis type ki aur kaunsi row ka comment hai. Isko **polymorphic relation** kehte hain.
explain: `morphs('commentable')` do columns banata hai: `commentable_id` aur `commentable_type` (model ka class naam).
`morphMany(Comment::class, 'commentable')` – parent side. `morphTo()` – child side jo owner ko pehchanta hai.
Isse ek hi table kai models ke liye kaam karti hai.

sections.heading: Morph map: class naam database mein mat rakho
sections.body: By default `commentable_type` mein poora class naam (`App\Models\Post`) jaata hai. Kal class ka naam/namespace badla to purana data toot jaata hai. Isliye chhote alias use karo:
explain: `enforceMorphMap` ke baad map mein na hone wala model use karne par error aayega, jo galti jaldi pakadta hai.

sections.heading: Polymorphic many-to-many: tags
sections.body: Ek tag posts par bhi aur videos par bhi lag sakta hai. Iske liye `taggables` pivot hoti hai aur `morphToMany`/`morphedByMany` use hote hain.

callout.text: Polymorphic tab use karo jab ek hi child table (comments, images, tags) kai alag parent models se jude. Ek hi parent ho to normal `hasMany` kaafi hai.

items.13: Same as 11. Naye fluent through-helpers ke liye official relationships docs dekho.

errors.error: No morph map defined for model [App\Models\Post]
errors.cause: `enforceMorphMap` laga hai par us model ka alias map mein nahi.

errors.error: Polymorphic relation se galat ya null model aa raha hai
errors.cause: `commentable_type` ki value (class naam ya alias) aur morph map match nahi karte.
errors.fix: Database mein `commentable_type` check karo aur morph map ke saath milao.

errors.cause: `morphs()` migration chali nahi ya naam alag hai.

debug.body: Polymorphic rows ko database mein seedha dekho:

code.code:
php artisan db:table comments
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Comment::first()->commentable

tasks: Morph map set karo aur database mein `commentable_type` dekho

options: Ek child table kai alag parent models se jude
quiz.why: Jab ek table (comments, images) kai models ke liye ho.

options: Database mein class naam ki jagah chhota alias jaata hai
quiz.why: Class rename hone par data na toote isliye alias use hota hai.

interview.a: Ek child model jo kai alag parent model types se jud sakta hai, `_id` aur `_type` columns se.
Jab do table ke beech ek beech ki table se related records chahiye, jaise Country -> User -> Post.

interview.q: Morph map kyun use karte hain?
interview.a: `_type` mein class ke poore naam ki jagah alias store karne ke liye, taaki rename safe ho.
`morphMany` parent side (post ke comments), `morphTo` child side (comment ka owner).
Tags jo posts aur videos dono par lag sakte hain: `morphToMany` aur `morphedByMany`, `taggables` pivot ke saath.

summary: `hasManyThrough` beech ki table se far related data deta hai.
Polymorphic mein child table `_id` + `_type` rakhti hai.
Morph map se class naam ki jagah alias store karo.
